purposes.wood_repeat_m: D4 face width/longitudinal repeat in metres; end grain uses the width repeat on both axes.
purposes.metal_repeat_m: D6 worked iron texture repeats in metres.
purposes.beam_bevel_m: Softens worked timber edges inside existing device bounds.
purposes.recovery_voxel_m: Closed surface recovery resolution for reusable organic cores, before coherent surface UV transfer.
purposes.core_length_m: Intact core height or tube length in game metres; source, recovered item and fixture reuse one geometry.
purposes.scar_depth_m: Physical inward channel depth, measured against the unchanged pre-cut surface.
purposes.scar_half_width_m: Width of the structural injury; dark margin is wider than its buried light.
purposes.lod_triangles: Selected candidate triangle targets for near, middle and far inspection; not an approved full-world budget.
purposes.native_bounds_m: Read-only existing gameplay body envelopes, in Godot XYZ.
purposes.review_lighting: Neutral isolated review lighting and a low ambient dark inspection, no bloom; not gameplay lighting tuning.
purposes.state_presentation.bore_colour: Quiet mineral colour for newly exposed bore faces that have no source albedo texture.
purposes.state_presentation.heart_work_tilt_radia: Maximum visual tilt while the existing native work cycle lifts the heart.
purposes.state_presentation.heart_work_lift_m: Maximum visible upward recovery travel without changing the source body or work cost.
purposes.state_presentation.tube_work_tilt_radian: Tube tilt during accepted native work; no new mechanical simulation.
purposes.state_presentation.husk_open_fraction: Horizontal opening of the persistent empty heart husk.
purposes.state_presentation.source_work_seconds: Short mineral glow following accepted source work only.
purposes.state_presentation.heart_phase_rate: Slow buried-light drift for the living heart and switched-on lamp; pauses with the tree.
purposes.state_presentation.lamp_emission: Buried-channel strength while the native lamp is on.
purposes.state_presentation.natural_heart_emissio: Quiet natural heart light, scaled by remaining native stock.
purposes.state_presentation.request_emission: Peak channel strength of a successful request; duration uses existing native pulse timing.
purposes.state_presentation.source_work_emission: Peak tube-channel strength during accepted source work, never an idle clock.
